content: GraphicWalker (Kanaries) performance guidance: <10K rows excellent, 10K-100K good, 100K-1M usable but should use server-side/custom computation, >1M requires it. Since this project has no backend, the equivalent is delegating computation to DuckDB-Wasm via the official duckdb-wasm-as-computation integration (gw-dsl-parser) rather than passing the full raw dataset as JS objects into GraphicWalker's default in-memory computation.
